How It Works

A rigorous,
systemised
approach.



Every engagement follows our proven four-step framework — built for accountability, rigour, and results that donors and stakeholders trust.

1

Align

Confirm purpose, key questions, stakeholders, and deliverables. Review documents and lock the evaluation framework together.

2

Collect

Design data collection tools. Deploy with ethics, consent, and rigorous quality controls built in from the start.

3

Analyse

Clean and validate datasets. Synthesize findings into actionable insights — including SWOT analysis where relevant.

4

Recommend

Produce practical reports with prioritised recommendations. Stakeholder validation, full handover, and continued support.
